shaft_root_radial_gap.interpretation: Clearance against inherited M291 bore; inferred, not a manufacturing tolerance. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

shaft_spline_side_gap.interpretation: Each spline flank gap against inherited rectangular groove. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

shaft_spline_tip_gap.interpretation: Tip gap against inherited groove floor. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

outer_journal_radius.interpretation: Approximate reduced outer journal from Plate22; no located printed diameter. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

inner_journal_radius.interpretation: Smooth journal over inferred spline-tip envelope; dimensions not printed. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

drum_hub_radius.interpretation: Inferred stepped hub from Plate22. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

drum_rim_stock.interpretation: Inferred radial rim stock. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

drum_web_stock.interpretation: Inferred central web stock. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

drum_blend_radial.interpretation: Straight meridian transition into the rim; casting fillets remain partial. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

spline_rotation_witness.interpretation: Virtual twist to demonstrate torque capture, not a pose. Bounds are not qualified ranges.

drum_rim_turn_inset.interpretation: Axial inset of straight meridian transition from each rim end. Bounds are not qualified ranges.
